title: Cozy 2+1 apartment — Intourist Residence
description: Cozy 2+1 apartment in the Intourist Residence residential complex. Address: Batumi, 17 Pirosmani St. 11th floor, 73 m². Convenient central location, about 5 minutes to the sea — 250 m. Well-developed neighbourhood infrastructure: shops, restaurants, pharmacies, transport, casinos and more. Central heating, gas. Well suited for living and rental income. Fully furnished with furniture and appliances. Smart home system, alarm and video surveillance. Backup power and heating for up to 10 hours during outages. Two balconies with views of the sea, city and mountains. Price: $188,000.
